chunks: Other than God? Can they save you or even save themselves?
ai.seo_question: What do the idols besides Allah have the power to do according to Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a logical refutation of polytheism by questioning the efficacy of idols in both granting victory and ensuring self-preservation. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a foundational argument for Tawhid, emphasizing that true reliance (Tawakkul) must be directed solely toward the All-Powerful, as false deities possess neither agency nor the capacity to aid their worshippers.
